- `hero.abstract.mset-tesseract.note`: the 16 arrangements of a ring of four as the corners of a four-dimensional cube; an edge is one Gibbs flip, a corner's size its chance; at T 1.2 the two all-agree corners hold 82.3%
- `hero.abstract.mset-trellis.label`: the trellis
- `hero.abstract.mset-trellis.note`: a chain of 10 pulled things as a trellis: each path is one arrangement, line widths the pair weights; summing paths column by column gives Z, as all 1,024 counted do
- `hero.abstract.msnd-aliasing.label`: aliasing
- `hero.abstract.msnd-aliasing.note`: a 9 Hz wave sampled 10 times a second: the samples (dots) lie exactly on a 1 Hz wave, so fewer than two samples a cycle cannot tell the two apart
- `hero.abstract.msnd-comma-spiral.label`: the Pythagorean comma
- `hero.abstract.msnd-comma-spiral.note`: twelve pure fifths of ratio 3/2, stacked: they come back 23.46 cents past seven octaves, so the circle of fifths never closes and equal temperament shares the gap out
- `hero.abstract.msnd-entropy-curve.label`: entropy and temperature
- `hero.abstract.msnd-entropy-curve.note`: a letter model counts what follows "the " in a short text; its softmax at temperature T has this entropy, near 0 bits cold and rising to log2 28, 4.81 bits, hot
- `hero.abstract.msnd-filter-q.label`: a resonant low-pass
- `hero.abstract.msnd-filter-q.note`: the cookbook biquad low-pass at 1 kHz with Q 0.5, 0.71 and 4: it passes the low part of a sound wave, and the higher the Q, the taller its resonant peak, 12 dB at Q 4
- `hero.abstract.msnd-flute-spectrogram.label`: the flute in time
- `hero.abstract.msnd-flute-spectrogram.note`: a short-time Fourier transform of the clear flute playing Sakura's first ten notes from A = 432: each note a stack of harmonics, the octave about 24 dB under the tone
- `hero.abstract.msnd-fm-bessel.label`: fm sidebands
- `hero.abstract.msnd-fm-bessel.note`: frequency modulation, as the lo-fi keys sound: at index 1.6 the sidebands spread (left), at 0.12 almost only the carrier is left (right); each height is |J_n(index)|
- `hero.abstract.msnd-gibbs-overshoot.label`: the Gibbs overshoot
- `hero.abstract.msnd-gibbs-overshoot.note`: a square wave summed from 5, 15 and 45 sines, seen at its jump: every sum overshoots by about 9% of the jump, and more sines only narrow the ring (Wilbraham 1848)
- `hero.abstract.msnd-harmonic-ladder.label`: the harmonic ladder
- `hero.abstract.msnd-harmonic-ladder.note`: the first 16 harmonics of 108 Hz, the bars at settle-hear's 0.5/k gains; below, how far each sits from the nearest equal-tempered note: the 7th 31 cents flat, the 11th 49
- `hero.abstract.msnd-isochronic-spectrum.label`: a gated tone
- `hero.abstract.msnd-isochronic-spectrum.note`: a 200 Hz tone switched on and off 40 times a second (above) and its spectrum (below): lines 40 Hz apart round 200, under the envelope of one burst's own spectrum
- `hero.abstract.msnd-sidechain-pump.label`: the sidechain pump
- `hero.abstract.msnd-sidechain-pump.note`: one bar of the DJ's sidechain duck: on every kick the pad's gain drops to 0.3 and swells back over 0.55 of a beat, so the wave breathes with the master beat
- `hero.abstract.myelin-nodes.label`: saltatory conduction
- `hero.abstract.myelin-nodes.note`: a schematic myelinated axon: the spike jumps from gap to gap (the nodes of Ranvier), carrying one all-or-none bit down the line
- `hero.abstract.pendulum-phase-portrait.label`: a phase portrait
- `hero.abstract.pendulum-phase-portrait.note`: a damped pendulum in phase space: every path spirals into rest
- `hero.abstract.phyllotaxis.label`: phyllotaxis
- `hero.abstract.phyllotaxis.note`: seeds placed at the golden angle, as a sunflower does
- `hero.abstract.phys-block-spins.label`: block spins
- `hero.abstract.phys-block-spins.note`: Kadanoff's block spins: a critical Ising lattice, each 3 by 3 block replaced by its majority, twice; at the critical point each view is statistically like the last
- `hero.abstract.phys-boltzmann-tomb.label`: Boltzmann's grave
- `hero.abstract.phys-boltzmann-tomb.note`: the formula carved on Ludwig Boltzmann's grave in Vienna, S = k log W: entropy is k times the logarithm of the number of ways
- `hero.abstract.phys-closure-domains.label`: closure domains
- `hero.abstract.phys-closure-domains.note`: one magnetic domain throws its field into the space around it; four domains in a ring close the flux inside and save that field energy
- `hero.abstract.phys-critical-ising.label`: the critical lattice
- `hero.abstract.phys-critical-ising.note`: an Ising lattice settled at the critical temperature 2/ln(1 + sqrt 2), about 2.269: domains of every size, nested inside each other
- `hero.abstract.phys-curie-point.label`: the Curie point
- `hero.abstract.phys-curie-point.note`: a magnet holds a cold iron nail, but a nail heated past iron's Curie point, 1043 K or about 770 C, loses its order and falls: heat wins over the pulls
- `hero.abstract.phys-energy-shelves.label`: filled by Boltzmann
- `hero.abstract.phys-energy-shelves.note`: 64 balls on seven evenly spaced energy shelves at kT of 1.6 steps: each shelf holds its share e^(-E/kT), 30, 16, 9, 5, 2, 1 and 1 from the bottom up
- `hero.abstract.phys-feynman-ratchet.label`: Feynman's ratchet
- `hero.abstract.phys-feynman-ratchet.note`: gas jostles vanes on an axle that turns a ratchet held by a pawl; when the pawl is as hot as the gas it jumps too, and on average nothing turns
- `hero.abstract.phys-free-expansion.label`: free expansion
- `hero.abstract.phys-free-expansion.note`: gas held in half a box; take the wall away and it fills the whole box, its entropy up by N k ln 2, and it never gathers back on its own
- `hero.abstract.phys-frustrated-plaquettes.label`: a spin glass
- `hero.abstract.phys-frustrated-plaquettes.note`: bonds that pull alike (solid) or apart (dashed), set at random; each diamond marks a square of four bonds that no choice of spins can please
- `hero.abstract.phys-frustrated-triangle.label`: frustration
- `hero.abstract.phys-frustrated-triangle.note`: three spins that each want to point against their neighbours: on a triangle one bond is always unhappy, whatever the third spin does
- `hero.abstract.phys-grain-growth.label`: grain growth
- `hero.abstract.phys-grain-growth.note`: annealing a metal grows its grains: a 48-state Potts model, early (left) and later at a low temperature (right); the boundaries shorten as grains merge
- `hero.abstract.phys-heat-engine.label`: a heat engine
- `hero.abstract.phys-heat-engine.note`: heat flows from a hot bath through an engine to a cold one; the band widths are the heats and the work at Carnot's limit, 1 - Tc/Th = 1/2 for 600 K and 300 K
- `hero.abstract.phys-iron-filings.label`: iron filings
- `hero.abstract.phys-iron-filings.note`: iron filings around a bar magnet: each filing turns along the field, and together they draw its lines from pole to pole
- `hero.abstract.phys-maxwells-demon.label`: Maxwell's demon
- `hero.abstract.phys-maxwells-demon.note`: a demon at a trapdoor sorts a gas, slow molecules left and fast ones right, so one side warms; Landauer's bill for erasing what it knew keeps the second law
- `hero.abstract.phys-nucleation.label`: nucleation
- `hero.abstract.phys-nucleation.note`: an Ising magnet below its critical point, started all down in a field that favours up: droplets of up form, and the large ones grow
- `hero.abstract.phys-percolation.label`: percolation
- `hero.abstract.phys-percolation.note`: squares filled at random with chance 0.593, the percolation threshold: the largest cluster (solid) just reaches from one side to the other
- `hero.abstract.phys-sandpile.label`: a sandpile
- `hero.abstract.phys-sandpile.note`: 16,384 grains dropped on one cell; any cell holding four or more topples one grain to each neighbour, and the pile settles to this same picture whatever the order of the topples
- `hero.abstract.phys-szilard-engine.label`: Szilard's engine
- `hero.abstract.phys-szilard-engine.note`: one molecule in a box: learn which side it is on, let it push the wall like a piston, and lift at most kT ln 2 of work, about 2.87e-21 J at 300 K, the price of one bit
- `hero.abstract.phys-three-temperatures.label`: three temperatures
- `hero.abstract.phys-three-temperatures.note`: one Ising lattice at three temperatures: cold and nearly all aligned, critical with domains of every size, hot and almost random
- `hero.abstract.phys-xy-vortices.label`: vortices
- `hero.abstract.phys-xy-vortices.note`: arrows free to turn in the plane, cooled fast from random: they line up except around vortices (rings) and antivortices (squares), where they wind once round
- `hero.abstract.predictive-coding.label`: predictive coding
- `hero.abstract.predictive-coding.note`: predictive coding as a schematic: each level sends a prediction down (solid) and gets the error back up (dashed); in Friston's account, minimising that error minimises free energy
- `hero.abstract.purkinje-fan.label`: a Purkinje fan
- `hero.abstract.purkinje-fan.note`: a schematic drawn in code: a Purkinje cell's flat fan of dendrites, crossed by parallel fibres; Kanerva matched his SDM to this circuit
- `hero.abstract.pyramidal-neuron.label`: a pyramidal cell
- `hero.abstract.pyramidal-neuron.note`: a schematic pyramidal neuron grown by random branching: a tuft at the top, basal dendrites below, the axon down; it sums thousands of inputs, like a p-bit sums its pulls
- `hero.abstract.random-walk.label`: a random walk
- `hero.abstract.random-walk.note`: a walker taking 2,600 random steps on a grid
- `hero.abstract.rann-crystal-seed.label`: one seed spreads
- `hero.abstract.rann-crystal-seed.note`: a liquid of 169 spins too cold to crystallise alone, and one held seed of 4: the crystal spreads to 22 by sweep 15, 81 by 28, all 169 by 48; with no seed, never past 3
- `hero.abstract.rann-falling-into-step.label`: falling into step
- `hero.abstract.rann-falling-into-step.note`: 64 oscillators, each with its own rhythm, each pulled toward its four neighbours as the noise cools: their order r goes 0.11, 0.86, 1.00, all in step
- `hero.abstract.rann-frustration-shared.label`: frustration shared
- `hero.abstract.rann-frustration-shared.note`: a spin glass of 196 spins in which 82 squares are frustrated, so some bonds must stay unhappy: annealing calms 218 quarrelling bonds to 90, then 54, shared out
- `hero.abstract.rann-gas-gathers.label`: gathering in
- `hero.abstract.rann-gas-gathers.note`: 89 particles that like to touch, moved one at a time as the gas cools, the count kept: 38 scattered clusters become 27, then one drop holding all 89
- `hero.abstract.rann-ising-agrees.label`: neighbours agree
- `hero.abstract.rann-ising-agrees.note`: 324 spins cooled by heat-bath sweeps, SETTLE's coin rule: from noise where 49% of neighbours agree, through domains at T 2.34 (86%), to every neighbour in agreement
- `hero.abstract.rann-patience-mends.label`: patience mends
- `hero.abstract.rann-patience-mends.note`: one hot start and random fields, 400 sweeps each: a quench (top) leaves walls 50 bonds long, a slow anneal (below) mends them all, with lower energy on 12 of 12 more lattices
- `hero.abstract.rann-side-by-side.label`: side by side
- `hero.abstract.rann-side-by-side.note`: two kinds of atom, 72 of each, that only swap places: begun apart (24 unlike neighbours), mixed by heat (144), then cooled slowly to settle side by side (64, then 40)
- `hero.abstract.rann-taking-turns.label`: taking turns
- `hero.abstract.rann-taking-turns.note`: 324 spins where every neighbour and every diagonal pair prefers to differ: no arrangement pleases them all, so cooling settles them into turns, 75% pleased (a checkerboard, 50%)
- `hero.abstract.rann-yinyang-couplings.label`: yin and yang
- `hero.abstract.rann-yinyang-couplings.note`: a yin-yang kept only in whether neighbouring spins agree or differ (a Mattis model), annealed out of noise: its overlap goes 0.04, 0.66, 1.00, all 324 spins in place
- `hero.abstract.reaction-diffusion.label`: reaction and diffusion
- `hero.abstract.reaction-diffusion.note`: two chemicals reacting and spreading settle into spots and stripes (Gray-Scott)
- `hero.abstract.restricted-boltzmann.label`: a restricted machine
- `hero.abstract.restricted-boltzmann.note`: a restricted Boltzmann machine: visible units below, hidden above, no links inside a layer
- `hero.abstract.rhop-blend-halfway.label`: meeting halfway
- `hero.abstract.rhop-blend-halfway.note`: a starting picture halfway between a candle and a sun settles into a blend of all three stored pictures: a stable state the Hopfield net was never taught, at energy -135 against the memories' -142
- `hero.abstract.rhop-bridge-mended.label`: a bridge mended
- `hero.abstract.rhop-bridge-mended.note`: a Hopfield net of 256 units holding an arch bridge, two figures and a house: a 6 by 6 block of the span is gone, and settling lays the 20 lost cells back
- `hero.abstract.rhop-candle-flipped.label`: the light returns
- `hero.abstract.rhop-candle-flipped.note`: a Hopfield net of 256 units storing a candle, a sun and a sprout: given the candle with 72 bits flipped, SETTLE at zero heat brings the light back
- `hero.abstract.rhop-chord-noise.label`: a chord through noise
- `hero.abstract.rhop-chord-noise.note`: salt and pepper on half the cells of a chord, 65 bits wrong: a Hopfield net holding a chord, a sun and a sprout settles it note by note, four panels
- `hero.abstract.rhop-dense-memory.label`: room for everyone
- `hero.abstract.rhop-dense-memory.note`: a dense associative memory, energy -sum (xi . s)^3, holds all nine pictures and recalls 54 of 54 corrupted copies; the plain Hopfield net with the same nine recalls 8
- `hero.abstract.rhop-gift-shifted.label`: a gift passed along
- `hero.abstract.rhop-gift-shifted.note`: a small move does not fool this Hopfield net: a gift shown 2 cells to the right, 85 bits off, settles to the gift where the net stored it
- `hero.abstract.rhop-shelter-one-sweep.label`: a shelter in one sweep
- `hero.abstract.rhop-shelter-one-sweep.note`: a house with 96 of its 256 bits flipped: one sweep of a Hopfield net, every unit taking the sign of its field once, and the shelter is whole
- `hero.abstract.rhop-sun-from-fragment.label`: the sun from a corner
- `hero.abstract.rhop-sun-from-fragment.note`: only the top-left corner of a sun, 81 of 256 cells, is shown to a Hopfield net holding a sun, a sprout and a yin and yang: the whole sun rises out of it
- `hero.abstract.rhop-yin-yang-whole.label`: two halves, one whole
- `hero.abstract.rhop-yin-yang-whole.note`: a Hopfield net holding a yin and yang, a house and a sun, shown only its right half: the 44 lit cells of the missing half come back and the two halves are one again
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-balance-restored.label`: balance restored
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-balance-restored.note`: a yin-yang with one quarter turned over (64 bits), read from an SDM of 10,000 hard-locations holding 8 pictures: 12 bits off, then whole and in balance
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-bridge-gap.label`: the gap bridged
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-bridge-gap.note`: a bridge with its middle span gone (34 bits), read from an SDM of 10,000 hard-locations holding 8 pictures: one read puts the span back and joins the two banks
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-circle-closes.label`: a circle closes
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-circle-closes.note`: a broken circle with 40 bits of noise, read again and again from an SDM of 10,000 hard-locations holding 8 pictures: 62, 26, 14 and 0 bits from whole, and it closes
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-dove-and-branch.label`: dove and branch
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-dove-and-branch.note`: two memories that recall each other in an SDM: a dove with 64 bits blurred reads the olive branch, all but 2 bits, which reads the dove back exactly
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-friend-returns.label`: a friend returns
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-friend-returns.note`: one figure alone, reaching out: read from an SDM of 10,000 hard-locations holding 8 pictures, the friend it holds hands with comes back, 41, 5 and 0 bits from the pair
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-heart-mends.label`: a heart mends
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-heart-mends.note`: a heart pulled apart and cracked, 84 of its 576 bits wrong, read from an SDM holding it and 3 other pictures: one read and it is whole
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-into-step.label`: falling into step
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-into-step.note`: two waves a quarter period out of step, read from an SDM of 10,000 hard-locations holding 8 pictures: 6 bits off, then in step, as they were stored
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-many-make-one.label`: many make one
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-many-make-one.note`: 30 writers each store their own rough copy of a star, a quarter of its bits wrong; one read of the SDM gives the true star, which no one wrote
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-pieces-meet.label`: two pieces meet
- `hero.abstract.rsdm-pieces-meet.note`: an SDM pointer chain: each step of two pieces coming together is stored at the step before; from a faint read-address (32 bits flipped) three reads bring them together, 49 times in 50
- `hero.abstract.rset-adder-backwards.label`: a sum shared
- `hero.abstract.rset-adder-backwards.note`: a 5-bit adder written as SETTLE penalties, its sum held at 44: the inputs settle from noise to 19 and 25, a pair that makes it
- `hero.abstract.rset-cup-calmed.label`: a cup calmed
- `hero.abstract.rset-cup-calmed.note`: a cup of tea with 10% of its pixels flipped: each p-bit leans toward what it saw and pulls on its neighbours; 56 pixels wrong, then 28 after the read
- `hero.abstract.rset-factor-meets.label`: two factors meet
- `hero.abstract.rset-factor-meets.note`: a p-bit multiplier run backwards: hold its product at 391 and let the bits settle; 23 and 17 come out, every partial product agreeing
- `hero.abstract.rset-latin-square.label`: a latin square
- `hero.abstract.rset-latin-square.note`: a 5 x 5 latin square as 125 p-bits, annealed by SETTLE: 21 clashes, then 10, then none, each symbol once in every row and column
- `hero.abstract.rset-mark-made-whole.label`: the mark made whole
- `hero.abstract.rset-mark-made-whole.note`: SETTLE's star as 400 p-bits, each leaning 1.4 toward it: its own pixels scrambled, one sweep later 38 still wrong, and the read of 16 sweeps puts every one back
- `hero.abstract.rset-maze-joined.label`: a way through
- `hero.abstract.rset-maze-joined.note`: a perfect maze's 69 corridors and cells as p-bits, each cell asking for two or none: the anneal joins the two ends by the one way through, 20 corridors long
- `hero.abstract.rset-no-neighbour-clashes.label`: no neighbour clashes
- `hero.abstract.rset-no-neighbour-clashes.note`: 19 nodes and 42 edges given 3 colours by annealing p-bits: 39 edges clash, then 19, then none, every neighbour different
- `hero.abstract.rset-puzzle-fitted.label`: the other piece
- `hero.abstract.rset-puzzle-fitted.note`: two jigsaw pieces and two other pictures stored as pulls; hold the left half and settle the right: half a sweep leaves 69 wrong, the read fits the piece exactly
- `hero.abstract.rset-queens-at-peace.label`: queens at peace
- `hero.abstract.rset-queens-at-peace.note`: 6 queens on a 6 x 6 board as p-bits, annealed: 50 attacks, then 19, 13, none, every queen safe
- `hero.abstract.rule-30.label`: rule 30
- `hero.abstract.rule-30.note`: the cellular automaton rule 30 grown from one cell
- `hero.abstract.rule-90.label`: rule 90
- `hero.abstract.rule-90.note`: the cellular automaton rule 90 grown from one cell: Sierpinski's triangle
- `hero.abstract.rwld-dove-recalled.label`: a dove recalled
- `hero.abstract.rwld-dove-recalled.note`: a dense associative memory of six birds recalls a dove from its right half, 61 bits off, exactly; a plain Hopfield net given the same half ends 112 bits away
- `hero.abstract.rwld-fireflies-sync.label`: fireflies in step
- `hero.abstract.rwld-fireflies-sync.note`: 40 fireflies with their own rhythms, coupled as Kuramoto oscillators: at first 12 flash together, then 24, then all 40, their order 0.98; their phases settle as one
- `hero.abstract.rwld-friend-recalled.label`: a friend recalled
- `hero.abstract.rwld-friend-recalled.note`: an SDM holding six faces: a friend's face read from its top half alone, 28 bits off, comes back 7 bits off after one read and exactly after two
- `hero.abstract.rwld-islands-bridged.label`: a bridge of cells
- `hero.abstract.rwld-islands-bridged.note`: SETTLE p-bits with two islands held as land, cooled over 600 sweeps: the strait settles into a bridge of cells, because one coast of 64 bonds costs less than two of 68
- `hero.abstract.rwld-moon-phases.label`: the moon follows on
- `hero.abstract.rwld-moon-phases.note`: an SDM written with the moon's phases, each at the address of the one before: a crescent with 19 of its 324 bits flipped reads the quarter, the gibbous, then the full moon
- `hero.abstract.rwld-sandpile-shares.label`: the sand shares
- `hero.abstract.rwld-sandpile-shares.note`: the Bak-Tang-Wiesenfeld sandpile: 700 grains heaped on the centre topple 9,242 times, each giving one grain to every neighbour, until all 700 rest with 3 or fewer a site
- `hero.abstract.rwld-snowflake-arms.label`: six arms agree
- `hero.abstract.rwld-snowflake-arms.note`: Reiter's snowflake model on a hexagonal lattice: from one frozen cell six arms grow in agreement, 481 cells after 371 steps, each cell matched by its turn of 60 degrees
- `hero.abstract.rwld-storm-calms.label`: the storm calms
- `hero.abstract.rwld-storm-calms.note`: a damped wave equation: the short waves die first, so a choppy sea becomes a long swell with 2.85% of its energy, then still water with 0.06%, and the little boat rides it out
- `hero.abstract.rwld-tree-from-seed.label`: a tree from a seed
- `hero.abstract.rwld-tree-from-seed.note`: a tree grown from a seed by a branching rule with coins in it: each bud opens into two branches 86% of the time, a p-bit's toss; 2, 5 and 9 generations, 236 branches
- `hero.abstract.sdm-bit-counters.label`: bit counters
- `hero.abstract.sdm-bit-counters.note`: the bit-counters of one hard location after many writes
- `hero.abstract.set-anneal-best.label`: anneal
- `hero.abstract.set-anneal-best.note`: anneal settles while it cools from 10 to 0.05 and keeps the calmest arrangement it passed (the star): energy -8 to -110
- `hero.abstract.set-ask-tally.label`: ask
- `hero.abstract.set-ask-tally.note`: ask counts how often a thing was yes: rain, with the grass held wet, in 30 of 50 kept samples (63.8% exactly)
- `hero.abstract.set-burn-in.label`: burn in
- `hero.abstract.set-burn-in.note`: a settle throws away its first tenth of sweeps (hatched) while the energy falls from -0.83 to -1.62, then keeps one sample a sweep
- `hero.abstract.set-denoise.label`: denoise
- `hero.abstract.set-denoise.note`: denoising as a settle: a house with 454 of 2,304 lights flipped, held as leans with neighbours pulled: 57 wrong after
- `hero.abstract.set-evidence-staircase.label`: evidence
- `hero.abstract.set-evidence-staircase.note`: a decision that leans no, pulled by five pieces of evidence: hold more of them yes and its chance climbs 0%, 0%, 3%, 40%, 94%, 100%
- `hero.abstract.set-factor-143.label`: factoring 143
- `hero.abstract.set-factor-143.note`: factoring as energy: each dot sized by exp(-(143 - p x q)^2 / 24); it reaches zero only at 11 x 13 and 13 x 11
- `hero.abstract.set-film-stages.label`: the film stages
- `hero.abstract.set-film-stages.note`: the film player's stages: a shaded ball, its leans, one draw of live p-bits, the average of 32 draws, the error left
- `hero.abstract.set-gray-counter.label`: a state machine
- `hero.abstract.set-gray-counter.note`: a state machine of settles: hold the state, settle, ask, hold the answer; it counts 00, 01, 11, 10, each step right 96.4%
- `hero.abstract.set-grid-magnifier.label`: the grid of lights
- `hero.abstract.set-grid-magnifier.note`: lights leaning toward a heart and pulled to their neighbours, settled as the hero settles; 5 of 528 disagree with it
- `hero.abstract.set-hold-pin.label`: hold
- `hero.abstract.set-hold-pin.note`: one light held yes in a pulled grid: its neighbours settle yes 79.3% of the time, the far edge 54.5%
- `hero.abstract.set-lean-seesaws.label`: a lean
- `hero.abstract.set-lean-seesaws.note`: the lean is how much a light wants to be yes; leans of -3 to 3 give it these chances, from the tanh rule
- `hero.abstract.set-map-colouring.label`: colouring a map
- `hero.abstract.set-map-colouring.note`: graph colouring as energy: six Australian states pushed off their neighbours' colours, annealed until no two neighbours share one
- `hero.abstract.set-max-cut.label`: max cut
- `hero.abstract.set-max-cut.note`: max cut as energy: a push on every edge splits 14 nodes so 18 of 21 edges cross, the best of all 16,384 splits
- `hero.abstract.set-nonogram.label`: a nonogram
- `hero.abstract.set-nonogram.note`: a nonogram as energy: the bars are each line's runs, the energy counts the misses, and annealing settled the cells to zero
- `hero.abstract.set-pbit-device.label`: a p-bit
- `hero.abstract.set-pbit-device.note`: a p-bit: a lean through tanh, plus even noise, then its sign; yes with chance (1 + tanh 0.6) / 2 = 0.77
- `hero.abstract.set-pull-push.label`: pull and push
- `hero.abstract.set-pull-push.note`: a pull of 1.5 makes two lights 20 times likelier to agree than to differ; a push of 1.5 the reverse
- `hero.abstract.set-sudoku-pips.label`: sudoku as energy
- `hero.abstract.set-sudoku-pips.note`: a four by four sudoku as an energy that counts repeats; swaps annealed it from 9 to 0 in 38 steps
- `hero.abstract.set-sweeps-spacetime.label`: sweeps
- `hero.abstract.set-sweeps-spacetime.note`: a pulled ring of 192 lights settling, one row a sweep down the page: 92 walls between yes and no merge to 6
- `hero.abstract.set-the-coin.label`: the coin
- `hero.abstract.set-the-coin.note`: one thing that leans yes by 1, settled 200 times: 174 came up yes, where the tanh rule says 88.1%
- `hero.abstract.set-weather-net.label`: the wet grass
- `hero.abstract.set-weather-net.note`: the wet-grass program: rain is yes 9.0% until the grass is held wet, then 63.8%, summed over every arrangement
- `hero.abstract.softmax-bars.label`: a softmax
- `hero.abstract.softmax-bars.note`: a softmax over fourteen choices: one tall, the rest small
- `hero.abstract.spanning-maze.label`: a maze
- `hero.abstract.spanning-maze.note`: a maze cut as a random spanning tree: one path between any two cells
- `hero.abstract.sparse-code.label`: a sparse code
- `hero.abstract.sparse-code.note`: a 640-bit word with about one bit in twenty set
- `hero.abstract.spike-raster.label`: a spike raster
- `hero.abstract.spike-raster.note`: forty simulated neurons firing at random (Poisson spikes), twenty of them driven harder for a fifth of a second: spikes as stochastic bits
- `hero.abstract.spin-lattice.label`: a spin lattice
- `hero.abstract.spin-lattice.note`: arrows up and down on a lattice: two domains and a ragged wall
- `hero.abstract.standing-waves.label`: standing waves
- `hero.abstract.standing-waves.note`: a string's first five modes, each drawn at both extremes
- `hero.abstract.stdp-window.label`: spike timing
- `hero.abstract.stdp-window.note`: spike-timing plasticity: a weight grows when the input spike comes just before the output spike (filled) and shrinks when it comes just after; time constant 20 ms
- `hero.abstract.synapse.label`: a synapse
- `hero.abstract.synapse.note`: a schematic synapse: the axon's knob full of vesicles, the gap with transmitter in it, receptors on the far side; its strength is a weight, as a pull is in SETTLE
- `hero.abstract.tanh-family.label`: the tanh rule
- `hero.abstract.tanh-family.note`: the p-bit rule (1 + tanh(beta I)) / 2 at four inverse temperatures
- `hero.abstract.truchet-tiles.label`: Truchet tiles
- `hero.abstract.truchet-tiles.note`: quarter-circle tiles set at random, which join into long paths
- `hero.abstract.two-source-interference.label`: interference
- `hero.abstract.two-source-interference.note`: two point sources: the crests where their waves add
- `hero.abstract.voronoi-cells.label`: Voronoi cells
- `hero.abstract.voronoi-cells.note`: each seed claims the points nearest to it
- `hero.abstract.world-analogy-width.label`: HOW WIDE
- `hero.abstract.world-analogy-width.note`: how often "the dollar of Mexico" comes back as the peso as the hypervectors widen from 8 to 1,024 bits: wider is surer
- `hero.abstract.world-binaural-ears.label`: BINAURAL
- `hero.abstract.world-binaural-ears.note`: a binaural pair, one of the sounds the 40 Hz mode can play beside the settles: 200 Hz in the left ear, 240 Hz in the right; the beat is made between the ears, so it needs headphones
- `hero.abstract.world-clear-flute.label`: THE FLUTE
- `hero.abstract.world-clear-flute.note`: the clear flute's wave and its harmonics in decibels: a sine, a quiet triangle an octave up and a faint third harmonic, as settle-hear builds it
- `hero.abstract.world-eighty-flashes.label`: 80 FLASHES
- `hero.abstract.world-eighty-flashes.note`: one bar of the site's master clock: 4 beats at 120 bpm, 2 s; the 40 Hz light flashes 20 times a beat, 80 a bar, and when it is on every settle on the page flashes with it
- `hero.abstract.world-four-oscillators.label`: FOUR WAVES
- `hero.abstract.world-four-oscillators.note`: the four wave shapes of a sound oscillator, sine, square, sawtooth and triangle, three cycles each
- `hero.abstract.world-house-bar.label`: ONE BAR
- `hero.abstract.world-house-bar.note`: one bar of the DJ's house kit in sixteenths: a kick on every beat, a clap on two and four, closed hats on the off-beats; the DJ and the hero's settle keep one master beat
- `hero.abstract.world-in-scale-keys.label`: THE IN SCALE
- `hero.abstract.world-in-scale-keys.note`: the pattern of five notes Sakura uses, E F A B C, marked on two octaves of keys: the in scale on E
- `hero.abstract.world-infinity-room.label`: INFINITY ROOM
- `hero.abstract.world-infinity-room.note`: a box with every wall a mirror, seen from inside: each light repeats at every reflection; the hero, where the settles play, is named the infinity room
- `hero.abstract.world-isochronic-bursts.label`: ISOCHRONIC
- `hero.abstract.world-isochronic-bursts.note`: an isochronic tone, another sound the 40 Hz mode can play beside the settles: 200 Hz switched on for 12.5 ms and off for 12.5 ms, 40 times a second
- `hero.abstract.world-letter-trie.label`: WHAT FOLLOWS
- `hero.abstract.world-letter-trie.note`: what follows "t" in a short text about settling: a tree of the next three letters, line weight the count a language model learns
- `hero.abstract.world-maps-compose.label`: MAPS COMPOSE
- `hero.abstract.world-maps-compose.note`: Kanerva's maps between country records compose: USA to MEX joined with MEX to SWE by XOR takes the dollar straight to the krona
- `hero.abstract.world-next-letter-vote.label`: THE VOTE
- `hero.abstract.world-next-letter-vote.note`: a small SDM language model reads "settl": the hard locations it wakes vote for the next letter, and e wins
- `hero.abstract.world-page-marks.label`: PAGE MARKS
- `hero.abstract.world-page-marks.note`: eighteen of the site's 9 by 9 page marks: the house, the Hamming ball, the memory grid, the speech bubble and more
- `hero.abstract.world-rate-hex-cells.label`: RATE THE DJ
- `hero.abstract.world-rate-hex-cells.note`: the five hex cells that vote on the DJ's set: three given, two at rest with their dim inner cell
- `hero.abstract.world-sakura-stave.label`: SAKURA
- `hero.abstract.world-sakura-stave.note`: the first four bars of Sakura, one of the old tunes the flute plays over the hero's settle, from the Tokyo Academy of Music's koto collection of 1888
- `hero.abstract.world-settle-kanji.label`: THE MARK
- `hero.abstract.world-settle-kanji.note`: the site's mark, 定 (to settle), as a 14 by 14 field of lights, read from the site's own code
- `hero.abstract.world-sixty-by-sixty.label`: 3,600 PLACES
- `hero.abstract.world-sixty-by-sixty.note`: a store of 3,600 hard locations on a 60 by 60 grid, as SDMCHAT's science page draws its own: one read wakes a few of them
- `hero.abstract.world-two-hop-read.label`: TWO HOPS
- `hero.abstract.world-two-hop-read.note`: a two-hop SDM read: the first read's answer is the second read's address; filled squares woke on hop one, rings on hop two
- `hero.abstract.world-two-mirrors.label`: TWO MIRRORS
- `hero.abstract.world-two-mirrors.note`: a lamp between two facing mirrors, seen from above: its images make a repeating pattern, twice the gap apart, shrinking with their distance from the eye
- `hero.abstract.world-vote-temperatures.label`: TEMPERATURE
- `hero.abstract.world-vote-temperatures.note`: the same vote at three temperatures: cold sharpens it toward the winner, hot spreads it out, as a settle does
- `hero.adjust.all.rotation`: the rotation: TRUE TIME 7 slots in 8, a visualiser 1 in 8
- `hero.adjust.aria`: Adjust the hero picture
- `hero.adjust.colour`: colour
- `hero.adjust.colour.aria`: colour mode
- `hero.adjust.cycle`: cycle
- `hero.adjust.echoes`: echo trails (the last pictures pulse behind the next)
- `hero.adjust.kinds`: rotations
- `hero.adjust.kinds.aria`: what the rotation deals
- `hero.adjust.neon`: neon
- `hero.adjust.only`: only
- `hero.adjust.only.all`: show all
- `hero.adjust.only.aria`: show only {name}

- `hero.eq.eq-actprob.note`: the activation-probability for n = 1000 and H = 447, Kanerva's example, computed here
- `hero.eq.eq-attention.note`: attention: queries matched to keys, a softmax, and a weighted sum of the values
- `hero.eq.eq-bind.note`: binding by XOR: the same key undoes it
- `hero.eq.eq-boltzmann.note`: the Boltzmann weight: low energy is likely, more so as T falls
- `hero.eq.eq-bundle.note`: bundling three binary hypervectors: each bit takes the majority
- `hero.eq.eq-critical.note`: the critical-distance: nearer than it, iterated-reads converge on the stored word
- `hero.eq.eq-crossentropy.note`: cross-entropy: the nats a code built for q spends on data from p
- `hero.eq.eq-detailed.note`: detailed balance: at equilibrium each move is as frequent as its reverse
- `hero.eq.eq-elbo.note`: the evidence lower bound: what variational inference raises
- `hero.eq.eq-entropy.note`: the Gibbs entropy: how many ways, weighted
- `hero.eq.eq-free.note`: free energy: the average energy less temperature times entropy
- `hero.eq.eq-gradient.note`: gradient descent: a step of size η down the slope of the loss
- `hero.eq.eq-hamming.note`: the Hamming distance: the bits two words differ in
- `hero.eq.eq-hebb.note`: the Hebbian rule: each stored pattern ξ adds the product of its two ends
- `hero.eq.eq-hopfield.note`: the Hopfield energy: stored patterns sit at its minima
- `hero.eq.eq-importance.note`: importance sampling: average under p using samples from q
- `hero.eq.eq-ising.note`: the Ising energy: pulls J between spins, leans h on each
- `hero.eq.eq-jarzynski.note`: the Jarzynski equality: the free energy difference from the work of many fast pulls
- `hero.eq.eq-kl.note`: the KL divergence: what the wrong code costs over the right one
- `hero.eq.eq-landauer.note`: Landauer: erasing one bit costs at least kT ln 2
- `hero.eq.eq-langevin.note`: Langevin dynamics: a gradient step plus noise of the right size samples e^(-E/T)
- `hero.eq.eq-magnetisation.note`: the magnetisation: the average spin
- `hero.eq.eq-metropolis.note`: the Metropolis rule: always go downhill, go uphill with probability e^(-ΔE/T)
- `hero.eq.eq-partition.note`: the partition function: every state's weight, summed
- `hero.eq.eq-pbit.note`: the p-bit rule: a coin whose lean I sets the chance of yes
- `hero.eq.eq-perplexity.note`: perplexity: e to the cross-entropy, in nats
- `hero.eq.eq-sdmread.note`: an SDM read is a vote: the woken hard-locations sum their bit-counters, and each bit is the sign
- `hero.eq.eq-softmax.note`: softmax: the Boltzmann weights of the scores z at temperature T
- `hero.expand`: Expand the hero on this page
- `hero.film.anneal.label`: annealing
- `hero.film.anneal.note`: cooled from T 5 to T 1 out of noise: the domains grow
- `hero.film.beat.label`: a beat
- `hero.film.beat.note`: two sound waves of 400 and 440 Hz and their sum: the sum swells and fades 40 times a second, the difference of the two
- `hero.film.bind-unbind.label`: binding and unbinding
- `hero.film.bind-unbind.note`: a letter bound to a random key by XOR turns to noise; the same key unbinds it exactly, a wrong key does not
- `hero.film.boltzmann-samples.label`: a Boltzmann machine sampling
- `hero.film.boltzmann-samples.note`: five units flip by Gibbs sampling; the visits to each of the 32 states grow to meet exp(-E) / Z
- `hero.film.bundle-forms.label`: a bundle forming
- `hero.film.bundle-forms.note`: sixteen random hypervectors joined one by one into a majority bundle: each stays similar to it, less as more join
- `hero.film.capacity-fill.label`: a memory filling
- `hero.film.capacity-fill.note`: an SDM takes word after word; recall from a noisy address stays exact, then falls as the hard locations crowd
- `hero.film.cerebellum-learns.label`: the cerebellum learns
- `hero.film.cerebellum-learns.note`: each climbing-fibre error weakens the active parallel-fibre synapses until the Purkinje cell goes quiet for that pattern alone
- `hero.film.coin-rule.label`: the coin rule
- `hero.film.coin-rule.note`: nine p-bits at leans from -2 to +2 toss together; the more they toss, the closer their shares of yes come to the tanh rule
- `hero.film.cool-to-order.label`: cooling to a word
- `hero.film.cool-to-order.note`: a settle-see field leaning toward the word SETTLE, cooled from T 6 to T 0.3: the word comes out of the noise
- `hero.film.ddyn-chaos-sync.label`: the butterfly shared
- `hero.film.ddyn-chaos-sync.note`: two Lorenz systems on one chaotic attractor; from frame 4 the second is pulled toward the first: the gap between them falls from 27.5 to 0.00005 and both stay chaotic
- `hero.film.ddyn-fiedler-fade.label`: two groups meet halfway
- `hero.film.ddyn-fiedler-fade.note`: consensus on a network of two groups joined by one bridge: each agrees inside by t = 1.6, then their gap fades as exp(-lambda2 t), lambda2 = 0.223, from 1.59 to 0.036
- `hero.film.ddyn-fireflies.label`: ten fireflies, one flash
- `hero.film.ddyn-fireflies.note`: a network of 10 pulse-coupled oscillators (Mirollo and Strogatz): each flash lifts the others a little and groups absorb one another, 10 becoming 1 by frame 14
- `hero.film.ddyn-flock-aligns.label`: a flock finds one heading
- `hero.film.ddyn-flock-aligns.note`: 70 Vicsek particles, each turning to the mean heading of its neighbours plus noise: from random headings the flock comes to one, its order rising from 0.06 to 0.99
- `hero.film.ddyn-gkl-consensus.label`: a ring comes to agree
- `hero.film.ddyn-gkl-consensus.note`: the GKL rule, each cell seeing three: a ring of 48 erases its disagreements in 53 steps; on 1,000 rings of 149 it finds the majority 0.812 of the time, a plain majority vote 0
- `hero.film.ddyn-kuramoto-onset.label`: the crowd falls into step
- `hero.film.ddyn-kuramoto-onset.note`: 120 oscillators, coupling K raised from 0.25 to 3: below the critical Kc = 1 they drift apart (r 0.075), above it they gather into one rhythm, r 0.816, on the law sqrt(1 - Kc / K)
- `hero.film.ddyn-limit-cycle.label`: one orbit for everyone
- `hero.film.ddyn-limit-cycle.note`: the van der Pol oscillator from 16 starts, 8 near rest and 8 far out: all wind onto one limit cycle, an attractor of amplitude 2.02, the farthest going from 2.05 to 0.05 away
- `hero.film.ddyn-oscillator-ising.label`: every link content
- `hero.film.ddyn-oscillator-ising.note`: an oscillator Ising machine: 10 phases, 15 links, 5 asking to differ; a second-harmonic pump pulls each phase to 0 or pi and all 15 links end satisfied, the Ising energy at -15
- `hero.film.ddyn-phase-memory.label`: a phase memory recalls
- `hero.film.ddyn-phase-memory.note`: 50 oscillators whose Hebbian coupling stores three phase patterns: from a third of them on the arch, the rest at random, the phases settle into the whole arch, overlap 0.21 to 1.000
- `hero.film.ddyn-two-starts-one-shape.label`: two starts, one shape
- `hero.film.ddyn-two-starts-one-shape.note`: the words you and me, each mapped again and again by Barnsley's four fern maps: both become one attractor, the share of lit lights they hold in common rising from 0.17 to 0.97
- `hero.film.dhop-film-basin-holds.label`: what is forgiven
- `hero.film.dhop-film-basin-holds.note`: how much noise a memory forgives (ring radius, in flipped bits of 64) as patterns are added: the classical basin is gone for good from 10 patterns, the dense one keeps 16 bits at 56
- `hero.film.dhop-film-capacity-ladder.label`: room for more
- `hero.film.dhop-film-capacity-ladder.note`: load rises on a 24-unit memory: recall from 10% noise for energies x^2, x^3, x^4 and exp; they fail near 6, 32 and 91 patterns, exp holds past 2,048
- `hero.film.dhop-film-cccp.label`: the bowl above
- `hero.film.dhop-film-cccp.note`: why a modern Hopfield net settles: the curve's concave part is replaced by its tangent, the bowl above it (thin line) has its lowest point at the next step, so the energy never rises
- `hero.film.dhop-film-dreaming.label`: dreaming
- `hero.film.dhop-film-dreaming.note`: 40 random starts of a Hopfield net, each ending in a true memory (disc) or a false one (ring); unlearning in sleep lifts the true ones from 7 to 28
- `hero.film.dhop-film-family-tree.label`: families reconcile
- `hero.film.dhop-film-family-tree.note`: a modern Hopfield net of twelve memories in three families that share parts; as beta falls its fixed points reconcile: twelve, then three family prototypes (beta 4.6 to 14.7), then one
- `hero.film.dhop-film-one-step.label`: one look is enough
- `hero.film.dhop-film-one-step.note`: attention as a Hopfield read: a picture with 77 of 256 bits flipped, its softmax weights over 12 stored pictures, and the picture one update returns (12 of 12 exact)
- `hero.film.dhop-film-sequence-circle.label`: the circle closes
- `hero.film.dhop-film-sequence-circle.note`: a sequence memory holding 16 turns of a clock hand plus 40 other patterns: the dense rule (right) walks the hand round and closes the circle, the classical rule (left) mixes them
- `hero.film.dhop-film-temperature.label`: warmth and memory
- `hero.film.dhop-film-temperature.note`: a Hopfield memory's overlap against temperature as load rises: dots are 400-unit Glauber runs, the line the replica solution; the memory phase shrinks and is gone by load 0.14
- `hero.film.dhop-film-tokens-gather.label`: tokens gather
- `hero.film.dhop-film-tokens-gather.note`: 40 tokens on a circle, each attending to all (inverse temperature 1); iterated, attention gathers them from 29 groups into 1, one agreement
- `hero.film.dhop-film-wells-merge.label`: two wells become one
- `hero.film.dhop-film-wells-merge.note`: the softmax energy of two close memories as beta falls: below beta 6.067 (measured; theory 6.014) the ridge between them goes and one shared well holds both
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-arithmetic-zoom.label`: a fair share of the line
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-arithmetic-zoom.note`: arithmetic coding of harmony: each letter takes its share of the line in proportion to its probability and the line zooms in; 32.35 bits in all, against 56 for plain bytes
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-bounds-meet.label`: two bounds meet
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-bounds-meet.note`: Blahut-Arimoto's steps on a noisy six-letter channel: the lower and upper bounds on its capacity close from 0.541 bits apart to 0.008 (a log scale), meeting near 1.06 bits
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-fountain.label`: any drops will do
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-fountain.note`: a fountain code: random droplets, each the XOR of a few of 64 blocks, and any of them will do; the peeling decoder frees the whole picture after 72 droplets, in cascades
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-hamming-repair.label`: a code that forgives
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-hamming-repair.note`: a bridge sent in 240 Hamming(7,4) blocks through a noisy channel; each syndrome names the one flipped bit, so 53 wrong pixels become 18 (only the 11 blocks hit twice stay hurt)
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-huffman-join.label`: the two smallest join
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-huffman-join.note`: Huffman's code for the letters of Pride and Prejudice: the two least likely join, again and again, until one tree holds all; 3.613 bits a letter against an entropy of 3.568
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-model-learns.label`: bits per byte, learned
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-model-learns.note`: letter models of order 0, 1 and 3 reading 60,001 bytes of Austen, paying -log2 p for each byte before learning it; order 3 ends at 2.743 bits per byte, gzip 2.970, bz2 2.481 (dotted)
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-page-curve.label`: page's curve
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-page-curve.note`: a random state of 12 qubits, cut after 0 to 12 of them: the entanglement entropy rises one bit a qubit and peaks at 5.281 bits (Page's average 5.279); both sides of a cut hold the same
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-sdm-bits.label`: the bits a memory holds
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-sdm-bits.note`: a Kanerva SDM of 2,000 hard-locations takes 1 to 7,500 writes: the ring read back blurs (0 then 95 of 256 bits wrong) while the information it holds climbs to about 96,000 bits
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-settle-decode.label`: decoded by settling
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-settle-decode.note`: two rings sent as a rate 1/2 Sourlas code through a channel flipping 6% of signs; p-bits settle at the matched temperature and 77 wrong bits fall to 15 in 48 sweeps
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-typical-set.label`: nearly all agree
- `hero.film.dinfo-film-typical-set.note`: every sequence of n coin flips with P(1) 0.2, weighted by probability: as n grows to 256 the surprise per flip gathers on the entropy, 0.722 bits; within 0.1 of it, 29% at n 8 and 96% at n 256
- `hero.film.dlrn-bridge.label`: a bridge between valleys
- `hero.film.dlrn-bridge.note`: two nets from two seeds sit in two valleys of the loss; the straight path climbs a barrier of 0.214 (dashes), a bent path trained 700 steps crosses at the valleys' own 0.020
- `hero.film.dlrn-grok-chord.label`: each unit finds its note
- `hero.film.dlrn-grok-chord.note`: the same net: 24 hidden units start listening to all 29 frequencies and each settles on one; a unit's share in its strongest frequency rises from 0.14 to 0.56
- `hero.film.dlrn-grok-circle.label`: the numbers make a ring
- `hero.film.dlrn-grok-circle.note`: the same net: its weights for the 59 numbers, seen through one frequency, untangle into a ring; the spread of their radii falls from 0.57 to 0.14 as the rule is learned
- `hero.film.dlrn-grok-late.label`: the rule arrives late
- `hero.film.dlrn-grok-late.note`: a net learns addition mod 59 from 40% of the table: every training sum by step 300, then weight decay brings the held-out sums home, half by step 3500 (dots: train, line: held-out)
- `hero.film.dlrn-muon-together.label`: every direction together
- `hero.film.dlrn-muon-together.note`: a linear net learns 8 directions, strong to faint: gradient descent leaves the faintest behind (left); Adam (middle) and Muon (right) bring all 8 to 90% by step 304 and 233
- `hero.film.dlrn-pentagon.label`: room for five
- `hero.film.dlrn-pentagon.note`: five sparse features share two dimensions through a ReLU: training spreads their weight vectors into a pentagon, every gap within 1.25 degrees of 72
- `hero.film.dlrn-rebasin.label`: matched, the blend holds
- `hero.film.dlrn-rebasin.note`: two nets blended weight by weight: paired by index (left) the boundary breaks midway and 17 of 120 held-out points go wrong (rings); matched first (right), a relabelling, only 1 does
- `hero.film.dlrn-sae-match.label`: atoms meet their features
- `hero.film.dlrn-sae-match.note`: a sparse autoencoder learns 16 directions mixed in 12 dimensions: each atom finds its own direction, mean |cos| 0.31 to 0.98, 15 of 16 above 0.95
- `hero.film.dlrn-sdm-grad.label`: gradient only where it read
- `hero.film.dlrn-sdm-grad.note`: one batch of 4,096 positions through our trained SDM model: the gradient reaches only the value rows its reads woke, 3,038 of 65,536 in the first table (bars: four hops)
- `hero.film.dlrn-tngd-settle.label`: natural gradient by settling
- `hero.film.dlrn-tngd-settle.note`: a thermodynamic way to the natural gradient: a particle settles in a tilted bowl under noise; its running average lands on A^-1 g within 0.9%, 43.3 degrees from the plain gradient
- `hero.film.dollar-of-mexico.label`: the dollar of Mexico
- `hero.film.dollar-of-mexico.note`: two records bound and bundled; their product maps one onto the other, and the dollar comes out as the peso
- `hero.film.domain-wall.label`: two domains and a wall
- `hero.film.domain-wall.note`: an Ising field below its critical temperature: the wall wanders, the domains hold
- `hero.film.dqua-chsh-mended.label`: a pair mended
- `hero.film.dqua-chsh-mended.note`: a shared pair measured 4,000 times a setting as its visibility is mended from 0 to 1: CHSH S passes Bell's classical 2 from 0.75 on and reaches 2.82; a local model gives 2.01
- `hero.film.dqua-grover-reflections.label`: two reflections, one turn
- `hero.film.dqua-grover-reflections.note`: Grover's search over 32 states as one vector: each oracle flip and mean reflection turns it 20.4 degrees toward the sought state, which holds 99.92% of the probability after 4 rounds
- `hero.film.dqua-landau-zener.label`: go gently and it follows
- `hero.film.dqua-landau-zener.note`: a spin swept through an avoided crossing at 14 speeds, fast to slow: fast, it is left behind (0.209 in the ground state); slow, it follows its guide all the way (0.993), as annealing does
- `hero.film.dqua-majority-repair.label`: neighbours repair
- `hero.film.dqua-majority-repair.note`: bit flips at probability 0.1 a round on 40 bare qubits and on 20 groups of 5 set back by majority vote, as an SDM reads: after 10 rounds 19 of 40 bare are right, 19 of 20 groups
- `hero.film.dqua-purify-climb.label`: many give for one
- `hero.film.dqua-purify-climb.note`: entanglement purification: two noisy pairs of spins are offered and one better pair is kept, round after round; the fidelity climbs from 0.6 to 0.855 in 8 rounds, 256 pairs given for one
- `hero.film.dqua-qaoa-layers.label`: the fair split gathers
- `hero.film.dqua-qaoa-layers.note`: QAOA on a SETTLE max-cut puzzle of 10 spins: the probability of each cut value, layer by layer; the best cut, 13 of 15 pulls, holds 0.002 with no layers and 0.987 with 12
- `hero.film.dqua-rabi-in-tune.label`: in tune, the full swing
- `hero.film.dqua-rabi-in-tune.note`: a spin driven as its detuning falls from 3 to 0: its Bloch orbit widens from a small circle, at most 0.1 of the way over, to the full swing from up to down
- `hero.film.dqua-repeater-bridge.label`: a bridge of neighbours
- `hero.film.dqua-repeater-bridge.note`: nine nodes joined to their neighbours by entangled pairs of spins, fidelity 0.97; each middle node gives its two links up in a swap, and the two ends are joined across at fidelity 0.791
- `hero.film.dqua-spin-echo.label`: the echo brings them home
- `hero.film.dqua-spin-echo.note`: twenty-four spins drift apart at their own rates until their mean vector is 0.017 long; one pi pulse halfway turns every phase back, and at twice the time they agree again exactly
- `hero.film.dqua-zeno-hold.label`: held by gentle checks
- `hero.film.dqua-zeno-hold.note`: a drive turns a spin from up to down; checked N times on the way it stays up with probability cos^(2N)(pi/2N): 0 with one check, 0.884 with 20
- `hero.film.dscale-capacity-knee.label`: more room, more memories
- `hero.film.dscale-capacity-knee.note`: a Kanerva SDM filling, read from a 10% noisy address: as hard-locations grow from 500 to 16,000 its capacity grows from 7 to 208 patterns, slope 1.00
- `hero.film.dscale-curves-descend.label`: four learning side by side
- `hero.film.dscale-curves-descend.note`: four of our models learning side by side over 200M tokens of one 65,522,263-token shard, the transformer lowest; past each dashed line the text they read repeats
- `hero.film.dscale-every-doubling.label`: every doubling gives
- `hero.film.dscale-every-doubling.note`: each doubling of training tokens takes bits off our transformer and our SDM: 0.119 and 0.098 for the first, then 0.04 to 0.06 each, the last two over repeated text
- `hero.film.dscale-fit-settles.label`: a curve meets its points
- `hero.film.dscale-fit-settles.note`: the curve L = E + A/N^a + B/D^b fitted step by step to nine scores of our SDM model: its error falls from 0.23 to 0.0016 bits as it settles onto them
- `hero.film.dscale-frontier-grows.label`: the best so far
- `hero.film.dscale-frontier-grows.note`: 232 runs of our models over 10.7 hours, placed by compute as they finished: the best score so far falls from 1.578 to 1.164 bits per byte
- `hero.film.dscale-how-far-back.label`: how far back it reads
- `hero.film.dscale-how-far-back.note`: our trained SDM model with one input token swapped: how far its later predictions move by distance back; no step after its 8 back slots, still 0.060 nats 100 tokens on
- `hero.film.dscale-memory-fades.label`: a token, remembered
- `hero.film.dscale-memory-fades.note`: where one token lives in our model's address as it moves back: in its 8 back slots one step at a time, then in 5 running averages; the slowest still holds 37% of it after 100 tokens
- `hero.film.dscale-seeds-agree.label`: two starts, one answer
- `hero.film.dscale-seeds-agree.note`: 29 settings of our models each trained twice from different random starts: 27 of the 29 pairs land within 0.005 bits per byte of each other, the median gap 0.0013
- `hero.film.dscale-widths-together.label`: the widths fall together
- `hero.film.dscale-widths-together.note`: our SDM model at widths 256, 384, 512 and 768 learning the same text: their quick scores fall together and keep their order at all 14 checks, the widest lowest
- `hero.film.dscale-window-grows.label`: window or batch
- `hero.film.dscale-window-grows.note`: every 200M-token run against its window: a longer window gave the transformer 0.019 bits, twice the tokens a step gave it 0.061, and lifted our SDM from 1.459 to 1.417
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-attention-emerges.label`: attention emerges
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-attention-emerges.note`: the hard-locations a read shares with 40 stored words of a real SDM, as M grows from 1,000 to 128,000: the bars settle on the exact lens, mean error 0.180 to 0.011
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-basins-fill.label`: the homes as it fills
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-basins-fill.note`: where iterated reads of a real SDM end, cell by cell in the plane of two words, as it fills from 10 to 120 words: the homes welcome from less far, 179 cells, then 9
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-collapse.label`: one curve
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-collapse.note`: a real SDM's critical-distance for 4 store sizes slides from words per hard-location to the load with shared-location noise counted: the curves gather, spread 23.2 to 11.4 bits
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-edge-sharpens.label`: the edge sharpens
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-edge-sharpens.note`: the share of reads an SDM brings home against how far they start, at one load, for 1,000 to 32,000 hard-locations: the edge stays put and sharpens from 0.24 to 0.08
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-flow-home.label`: coming home
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-flow-home.note`: 80 lost addresses near two stored words of a real SDM, one read a frame: 19 and 44 come home, the second word waking 83 hard-locations to 65; 17 rest between them
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-four-memories.label`: four memories
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-four-memories.note`: our SDM mixer's four heads read one address written at every earlier position: one hears every writer equally, the others fade with half-lives of 693, 69 and 7 tokens
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-mixer-kernel.label`: turning apart
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-mixer-kernel.note`: two addresses of our SDM mixer turn apart from cosine 1 to 0: the share of the read they hold in common falls as an exponential, beta 4.05, beside Kanerva's lens (rings)
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-old-friends-kept.label`: old friends kept
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-old-friends-kept.note`: an SDM keeps 20 old words while a new cluster is written: a wide activation (p 0.026) holds them to 10 new words, a narrow one (p 0.0007) keeps 70% whole after 800
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-radius-to-beta.label`: a wider welcome
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-radius-to-beta.note`: the share two activation circles hold in common, log scale, as the activation-radius widens: beta falls from 7.0 to 1.7, a wider welcome is a gentler attention
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-two-roads-home.label`: two roads home
- `hero.film.dsdm-film-two-roads-home.note`: one SDM read again and again (left) and softmax attention at beta 3.59 (right) from the same noisy starts: from 48 bits off 39 and 40 of 40 come home, from 80 bits 21 and 20
- `hero.film.dspr-boost-every-column.label`: every column gets a turn
- `hero.film.dspr-boost-every-column.note`: a spatial pooler of 64 columns, 4 winners for each input pattern: without boosting the busiest wins 2.32 times its fair share and the quietest 0.35, with boosting 1.3 and 0.88
- `hero.film.dspr-columns-agree.label`: columns that agree
- `hero.film.dspr-columns-agree.note`: four columns each sense a different part of one object among 1,000: alone each keeps 322 to 350 that fit, and as they vote all four hold the same 9, then the same one
- `hero.film.dspr-fields-form.label`: each finds its own part
- `hero.film.dspr-fields-form.note`: a boosted pooler learning from random bar patterns on an 8 by 8 input: its fields sharpen into single rows and columns, 53 of 64 a clean bar, all 16 bars taken
- `hero.film.dspr-fragment-enough.label`: a fragment is enough
- `hero.film.dspr-fragment-enough.note`: keep 3 of a code's 40 bits and it still shares more with itself than the best of 10,000 random strangers does; only at 2 bits do they tie
- `hero.film.dspr-kwta-level.label`: a fair level
- `hero.film.dspr-kwta-level.note`: k-winners-take-all as a dual ascent: the inhibition level rises while more than 8 of 40 units are on and settles at 0.843, leaving exactly the 8 strongest
- `hero.film.dspr-noise-forgiven.label`: noise forgiven
- `hero.film.dspr-noise-forgiven.note`: each of a code's 40 bits moved with probability f: at f = 0.5 it still matches itself on 20 shared bits 56.55% of the time, the binomial law says 56.27%
- `hero.film.dspr-our-read-code.label`: our read as a sparse code
- `hero.film.dspr-our-read-code.note`: our SDM model wakes 32 of 65,536 locations a token; over 2,560 tokens of held-out prose it wakes 1,733 locations, and a quarter of all wakes go to 32 of them
- `hero.film.dspr-sparsity-balance.label`: the balance of sparsity
- `hero.film.dspr-sparsity-balance.note`: unions of codes in 2,048 bits matched on all their bits, held to one false match in a billion: 3 codes fit at 4 active bits, 47 at 28, 14 at 400
- `hero.film.dspr-union-holds-many.label`: room for many
- `hero.film.dspr-union-holds-many.note`: 40-bit codes ORed into one union of 2,048 bits: with 30 inside it turns away 99.99% of strangers, at 80 inside 81% of strangers match, and every member always does
- `hero.film.dspr-union-of-candidates.label`: a choir clears sooner
- `hero.film.dspr-union-of-candidates.note`: a column's guesses as the union of their 40-cell codes in 4,096 cells: alone it needs 6 sensations to thin 3,951 cells to one object's 40, four that vote need 2
- `hero.film.dthm-energy-shared.label`: energy shared
- `hero.film.dthm-energy-shared.note`: a gas of 480 where one in ten holds all the energy; colliding pairs split theirs at random until the first holders keep 9.9% and the spread meets the Boltzmann law (dots)
- `hero.film.dthm-flat-histogram.label`: a flat histogram
- `hero.film.dthm-flat-histogram.note`: Wang-Landau on a 6 x 6 Ising lattice visits every energy equally; its count of arrangements at each of 35 energies (bars) meets the exact count (dots), off by 0.173 in the log
- `hero.film.dthm-invertible-adder.label`: an adder run backwards
- `hero.film.dthm-invertible-adder.note`: five p-bits as a full adder, energy (A + B + C - S - 2K)^2; the sum is held, the inputs settle: held at 2, 98% of samples are 011, 101 or 110; at 1, 97.8% are 001, 010 or 100
- `hero.film.dthm-island-heals.label`: the island heals
- `hero.film.dthm-island-heals.note`: a disc of 1,396 minus spins in a sea of plus at T 1 under heat-bath sweeps: its border rounds and shrinks it, the area falling 3.28 a sweep, gone by sweep 430
- `hero.film.dthm-potts-merge.label`: three states merge
- `hero.film.dthm-potts-merge.note`: a three-state Potts lattice at T 0.6, below its critical temperature 0.995: only the borders between states are lit, and they fall from 35.2% to 1.9% of bonds by sweep 438
- `hero.film.dthm-slow-cooling.label`: slow cooling heals
- `hero.film.dthm-slow-cooling.note`: three Ising lattices cooled from twice the critical temperature to 0 over 16, 64 and 256 sweeps; only domain walls are lit, and they leave 7.9%, 3.3% and 0% of bonds broken
- `hero.film.dthm-tempering-gift.label`: a state handed down
- `hero.film.dthm-tempering-gift.note`: parallel tempering: walkers at temperatures 2, 1, 0.5 and 0.25 swap places; hot ones find the deep valley and hand it down, the coldest keeping it 99.8% of the time; alone, never in 100,000 steps
- `hero.film.dthm-two-chains-meet.label`: two chains agree
- `hero.film.dthm-two-chains-meet.note`: coupling from the past on a 32 x 32 Ising lattice at T 2.6: the all-up and all-down chains share their random numbers; begun 128 sweeps back, they agree by sweep 120, an exact sample
- `hero.film.dthm-two-solids.label`: one temperature
- `hero.film.dthm-two-solids.note`: two Einstein solids of 24 and 48 oscillators share 96 quanta, all in the first at the start; quanta hop at random until both stand level, the first holding 32.4 on average (its fair share 32)
- `hero.film.dthm-two-urns.label`: two urns even out
- `hero.film.dthm-two-urns.note`: the Ehrenfest urns: 40 balls start in the left urn and one hops at random each step; the exact probability of each count (bars) moves onto the binomial (dots), mean 20.92 after 60 steps
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-capacity-sweep.label`: room to agree
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-capacity-sweep.note`: how large a search a resonator settles 9 times in 10, over 100 tries a point: 32 rows a codebook by sign, 64 with threshold and noise in 256-bit vectors; 48 and 128 at 512 bits
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-clocks-agree.label`: clocks fall into step
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-clocks-agree.note`: 32 phasor clocks of a query vector against a stored one: as the query comes home the hands fall into step and similarity rises to 1.00; one step away it reads -0.12, near sinc 0
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-four-algebras.label`: every pair kept
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-four-algebras.note`: 4 to 80 pairs bound in 512-number vectors by four algebras (top to bottom FHRR, MAP, HRR, binary); each column a read: at 80 pairs 62, 46, 39 and 28 come back
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-function-whole.label`: a curve made whole
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-function-whole.note`: samples of a curve bundled into one vector of 1,024 phasors, one more each frame: read back everywhere, the curve comes whole, its rms error falling from 0.73 to 0.03
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-kernel-shapes.label`: a kernel widens
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-kernel-shapes.note`: the phases of a 1,024-phasor vector on a narrowing arc: the similarity kernel they make widens, its first zero moving from 1 to 8, within 0.035 of the sinc theory
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-limit-cycle.label`: a cycle let go
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-limit-cycle.note`: a resonator untangling a hypervector, caught in a cycle of 11 sweeps (96 rows a codebook); a threshold and a little noise at sweep 107 let it go, and its factors agree at sweep 130
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-many-agree.label`: many resonators agree
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-many-agree.note`: 48 resonators each untangle a hypervector bound from three factors (16 rows a codebook): a dot is how near two of its guesses are; 45 come to full agreement by sweep 30
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-noise-helps.label`: the noise that frees
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-noise-helps.note`: the same 48 hypervector factorings at 48 rows a codebook: the sign resonator settles 14 in 600 sweeps; with a threshold and a little noise all 48 find their factors
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-peel.label`: the quiet ones heard
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-peel.note`: 48 vectors summed in 256 numbers, read among 400: a plain top-48 hears 37; peeling the loudest away lets the quieter rise past the strangers, and all 48 are heard
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-wider-truer.label`: wider is calmer
- `hero.film.dvsa-film-wider-truer.note`: 20 samples of a curve held in vectors from 8 to 2,048 phasors wide: the read wobbles around the exact kernel curve, and the wobble falls from 0.99 to 0.08
- `hero.film.eaip-film-association-chain.label`: one memory calls the next
- `hero.film.eaip-film-association-chain.note`: a real SDM holds six pictures as a chain, each written at the address of the one before: from a cue 40 bits off the first read is 10 bits wrong, and the next four come back exact
- `hero.film.eaip-film-eight-stage-cooling.label`: eight steps of cooling
- `hero.film.eaip-film-eight-stage-cooling.note`: a metaphor in a model: an Ising lattice cooled from noise in eight stages, temperature 4 down to 1; the energy per spin falls from -0.56 to -2, one calm domain, as 70% of 40 runs end
- `hero.film.eaip-film-field-sweeps.label`: a field sweeps by
- `hero.film.eaip-film-field-sweeps.note`: a metaphor in a model: a knot of spins pinned against the lattice while a soft field sweeps left and right; as the pin eases the knot joins by frame 16, and held fully pinned it never does
- `hero.film.eaip-film-halves-take-turns.label`: two halves take turns
- `hero.film.eaip-film-halves-take-turns.note`: a model: two halves of a lattice start opposed, updated in turns, each feeling the other only as a growing mean field: in 60 runs they agree 100% of the time, and 0% with no link
- `hero.film.eaip-film-island-links.label`: an island is linked in
- `hero.film.eaip-film-island-links.note`: a model: a ring of 24 spins and an island of 6 set against it, Gibbs sampled at temperature 0.9; as 18 links join them, the island agrees in 3.2, then 6 of its 6 spins (300 runs)
- `hero.film.eaip-film-lattice-scan.label`: a scan finds strays
- `hero.film.eaip-film-lattice-scan.note`: a model: a lattice with 6% of its spins flipped; a scan walks down two rows a frame and behind it every spin its neighbours outvote turns: 57 high-energy sites become 0
- `hero.film.eaip-film-loud-memory-shares.label`: the strong one shares
- `hero.film.eaip-film-loud-memory-shares.note`: a Hopfield model of 120 units, one of 5 patterns stored 3 times as strongly: it catches 95% of 150 random starts; eased to equal weight it keeps 18%, the others 18 to 24 starts each
- `hero.film.eaip-film-recall-rewrites.label`: recalled and rewritten
- `hero.film.eaip-film-recall-rewrites.note`: a Hopfield model: a memory of two apart squares is recalled, nudged gently toward a linked memory of a whole ring and stored again; over 8 recalls its overlap with the ring goes 0.34 to 0.91
- `hero.film.eaip-film-two-wells-breathe.label`: two wells share
- `hero.film.eaip-film-two-wells-breathe.note`: a model: 120 walkers start in the left of two wells; the barrier lowers while a slow tilt swings left and right and fades: they end 60 and 60, the even share of detailed balance, 50%
- `hero.film.eaip-film-wide-basin.label`: into the wide basin
- `hero.film.eaip-film-wide-basin.note`: a model: 300 walkers start in a deep, narrow well; warmed gently, then cooled slowly, 74% settle in the wide basin, where the Boltzmann weights at the last temperature put 73%
- `hero.film.econd-bond-stays.label`: the memory stays
- `hero.film.econd-bond-stays.note`: an SDM pair, a tree over a sharp line, read and written back with a gentle line: the tree returns 336 of 336 bits every read while the line turns gentle, half way by read 6
- `hero.film.econd-calm-boundary.label`: a steady border
- `hero.film.econd-calm-boundary.note`: an Ising lattice at T 1.9 with its border held up settles to m = 0.95 inside (mean of 20 runs); with open edges and no border it averages m = 0.08, split into domains
- `hero.film.econd-frustration-eases.label`: frustration eases
- `hero.film.econd-frustration-eases.note`: a +-J spin glass cooled slowly: its unsatisfied bonds (bars) fall from 232 to 66; its 104 frustrated squares need at least 52, and a quench keeps 71.08 on average
- `hero.film.econd-many-colours-one.label`: many patches, few
- `hero.film.econd-many-colours-one.note`: a three-state Potts lattice at temperature 0.5 from noise: 174 same-state patches merge into 2 after 180 sweeps, and the largest state holds 55% of the sites
- `hero.film.econd-patch-heals.label`: a circle closes
- `hero.film.econd-patch-heals.note`: a disc of 256 flipped spins in an ordered Ising lattice at T 1.5 closes at a steady 2.27 sites a sweep (a straight line, R^2 0.96) and is gone after 99 sweeps
- `hero.film.econd-pendulum-sampler.label`: a sampler that swings
- `hero.film.econd-pendulum-sampler.note`: Hamiltonian Monte Carlo in a double well at T 0.45: one leapfrog swing a frame (marks); 99% of 3,000 swings are accepted, 240 cross the barrier, and the bars meet Boltzmann's law
- `hero.film.econd-replicas-exchange.label`: walkers share finds
- `hero.film.econd-replicas-exchange.note`: four walkers on one rugged energy line at T 0.12 to 1.6 swap states (dotted): the coldest reaches the deep well at frame 8; over 2,000 rounds it sits there 57% of the time, alone 0%
- `hero.film.econd-resonant-hops.label`: noise keeps time
- `hero.film.econd-resonant-hops.note`: particles in a two-valley energy landscape, rocked slowly left and right: at T 0.25 the noise lets them hop in time, 68% on the favoured side; with no rock 50%, too cold (T 0.08) 50%
- `hero.film.econd-small-settles-first.label`: small ones settle first
- `hero.film.econd-small-settles-first.note`: three Ising lattices of 5, 10 and 20 cooled to T 1.6 from noise: the median sweeps to 90% order over 24 runs are 4, 12 and 55.5, so the small ones settle first
- `hero.film.econd-two-temperatures.label`: one temperature
- `hero.film.econd-two-temperatures.note`: two Ising halves, one at T 1.26 and one at T 2.73, share a seam with the energy kept exactly; read from their demons they come to 2.19 and 2.36
- `hero.film.edeb-film-bridges-built.label`: bridges bring agreement
- `hero.film.edeb-film-bridges-built.note`: two groups of p-bits begin in opposite states and a bridge joins them each frame; here they agree from frame 3. With bridges 40 of 40 seeded runs agree, with none 0 of 40
- `hero.film.edeb-film-following-light.label`: following the light
- `hero.film.edeb-film-following-light.note`: a pocket of field moves slowly side to side along a chain of 90 p-bits; the up region follows it about 2 frames behind, one second at this pace
- `hero.film.edeb-film-free-spin.label`: a free spin
- `hero.film.edeb-film-free-spin.note`: a lattice of p-bits cools and orders, unlike neighbours falling from 0.35 to 0.04, while one spin with no bonds at all keeps flipping freely, up in 10 of 16 frames
- `hero.film.edeb-film-kinder-recall.label`: a recall comes back kinder
- `hero.film.edeb-film-kinder-recall.note`: a toy Hopfield memory: each recall of a sharp zigzag is followed by a little unlearning and a little rehearsal of a calm wave on its path; from the 8th recall it returns as the wave
- `hero.film.edeb-film-light-drifts.label`: a light drifts across
- `hero.film.edeb-film-light-drifts.note`: a soft light drifts slowly left and right across a lattice of p-bits; behind it the domains smooth, unlike neighbours falling from 0.30 to 0.13, against 0.16 with no light
- `hero.film.edeb-film-many-schedules.label`: four roads, one valley
- `hero.film.edeb-film-many-schedules.note`: four cooling schedules on one small spin glass, linear, geometric, slow start and stepped: all four reach the same floor, energy -43, the lowest of all 16,384 states
- `hero.film.edeb-film-studies-gather.label`: many samplers gather
- `hero.film.edeb-film-studies-gather.note`: 64 samplers of one ring, 17 to 1,410 sweeps long, arrive four a frame: short ones scatter, long ones gather near the exact 0.379, and their weighted pool settles at 0.381
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-leanings.label`: two leanings meet
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-leanings.note`: two camps of samplers of one ring with no field, each nudged its own way by a small field: one reads 0.26, the other -0.24, and their average reads 0.01, near the true 0
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-orders-one-law.label`: two orders, one law
- `hero.film.edeb-film-two-orders-one-law.note`: one 8-spin ring sampled two ways, site by site (top) and at random sites (below): after 8,593 sweeps each histogram is within 0.014 and 0.011 of the exact law
- `hero.film.edeb-film-well-softens.label`: the well softens
- `hero.film.edeb-film-well-softens.note`: a model: walkers held in a deep narrow well, the well softening, a gentle reheat and a slow cool; the share in the wide calm basin grows from 0% to 100%. The bar is the temperature
- `hero.film.eevid-band-narrows.label`: the band narrows
- `hero.film.eevid-band-narrows.note`: a model: one p-bit with lean 0.3, sampled six times a column; its running mean goes from -0.333 to 0.250 after 576 samples as the two-standard-error band shrinks from 0.779 to 0.079
- `hero.film.eevid-barrier-lowers.label`: the barrier lowers
- `hero.film.eevid-barrier-lowers.note`: a model: 400 Metropolis walkers start in a narrow well; as the barrier to a wide basin of the same depth lowers, 76.0% come to rest on the wide side, against Boltzmann's 75.2%
- `hero.film.eevid-cooled-and-waiting.label`: one cooled, one waiting
- `hero.film.eevid-cooled-and-waiting.note`: a model: two copies of one hot Ising lattice; the cooled copy falls from -0.37 to -1.89 energy per site while the copy held at T 5.0 ends at -0.37, and the bars show the gap
- `hero.film.eevid-field-drifts.label`: a field drifts side to side
- `hero.film.eevid-field-drifts.note`: a model: a gentle field patch swings left and right over a cooling Ising lattice, once every four seconds, and the lattice's magnetisation rises from -0.04 to 0.97
- `hero.film.eevid-fragment-recalls.label`: half an address recalls
- `hero.film.eevid-fragment-recalls.note`: a model: a Kanerva SDM of 1,600 hard-locations in 256 bits holds five pictures; read from only the left or the right half of an address, 9 of 10 reads return all 256 bits
- `hero.film.eevid-halves-take-turns.label`: two halves take turns
- `hero.film.eevid-halves-take-turns.note`: a model: two halves of one Ising lattice start opposed and take turns to update, two frames each; the right half's magnetisation climbs from -1.00 to 0.93 and the halves agree
- `hero.film.eevid-pooled-estimate.label`: small runs, pooled
- `hero.film.eevid-pooled-estimate.note`: a model: fourteen small runs of one p-bit, 7 to 51 samples each, estimate its lean of 0.5; every band holds 0.5, and their inverse-variance pool narrows to 0.486, plus or minus 0.101
- `hero.film.eevid-recall-comes-back-kinder.label`: a memory comes back rounder
- `hero.film.eevid-recall-comes-back-kinder.note`: a model: a 400-unit Hopfield memory recalls a spiky star from a cue with overlap 0.405; re-stored as a rounder disc, 84 bits changed, the same cue now settles to the disc
- `hero.film.eevid-replicas-agree.label`: four replicas agree
- `hero.film.eevid-replicas-agree.note`: a model: four replicas of one 22 x 22 Ising lattice cool from T 4.0 to 1.4 under a shared field of 0.08, and the sites where all four agree rise from 16.3% to 98.8%
- `hero.film.eevid-two-roads-one-valley.label`: two roads, one valley
- `hero.film.eevid-two-roads-one-valley.note`: a model: at one temperature, Gibbs from all spins up and Metropolis from noise start at -1.63 and -0.60 energy per site; over 2,000 more sweeps they average -1.028 and -1.037
- `hero.film.ehist-band-sweeps.label`: a band sweeps the lattice
- `hero.film.ehist-band-sweeps.note`: a frozen Ising mosaic and a soft band of field drifting slowly left and right: where it passes the barriers lower and the domains join, from 66% lit to 98%
- `hero.film.ehist-fragment-finds-memory.label`: a fragment finds its memory
- `hero.film.ehist-fragment-finds-memory.note`: a Hopfield network holding four pictures, given only the lower half of one: update by update the whole house returns, overlap 0.71 to 0.99 (thumbnails, right)
- `hero.film.ehist-help-passed-along.label`: help passed along
- `hero.film.ehist-help-passed-along.note`: a model of bond percolation at p = 0.6, above the threshold 0.5: from one site, help passes along open bonds shell by shell until 444 sites join and the cluster spans the lattice
- `hero.film.ehist-pendulum-quiets.label`: the swing grows quiet
- `hero.film.ehist-pendulum-quiets.note`: forty copies of a driven swing in a warm bath: as the bath cools 16 times the cloud tightens 3.5 times, near the 3.3 that equipartition predicts
- `hero.film.ehist-quench-or-anneal.label`: quench or anneal
- `hero.film.ehist-quench-or-anneal.note`: one rugged Ising landscape, two runs: frozen at once (left) it keeps its quarrels, cooled slowly from T 3.5 (right) it reaches energy -1.97 against -1.86
- `hero.film.ehist-reciprocal-inhibition.label`: two that take turns
- `hero.film.ehist-reciprocal-inhibition.note`: two p-bit populations that inhibit each other, the switch Wolpe called reciprocal inhibition: as one is gently biased on, the other lets go, crossing at frame 10
- `hero.film.ehist-regions-in-step.label`: five rings fall into step
- `hero.film.ehist-regions-in-step.note`: a model of synchrony, five rings of Kuramoto oscillators in step inside: as the coupling between rings rises they agree as one, the order parameter (bar) going from 0.07 to 0.97
- `hero.film.ehist-seed-grows.label`: one seed, a whole lattice
- `hero.film.ehist-seed-grows.note`: an Ising lattice at T 1.2 under a gentle field: one small lit seed grows by Metropolis flips until agreement fills the grid, from 1.0% lit to 99.9%
- `hero.film.ehist-two-sides-meet.label`: two sides meet
- `hero.film.ehist-two-sides-meet.note`: two coupled Ising layers that start opposite, one lit and one dark: warmed, then cooled slowly, they come to agree on 100% of their sites (the bridge between them)
- `hero.film.ehist-walk-light.label`: a narrow well, a wide basin
- `hero.film.ehist-walk-light.note`: a model, not a mechanism: walkers held in a narrow well are warmed (thermometer, 0 to 10) and cooled slowly, and 75% settle in the wider, lower basin
- `hero.film.eight-queens.label`: eight queens
- `hero.film.eight-queens.note`: queens moved by the Metropolis rule as the temperature falls; a line joins each pair that attack, until none do
- `hero.film.emech-barrier-lowers.label`: the barrier lowers
- `hero.film.emech-barrier-lowers.note`: 240 Metropolis walkers in a double well at T 0.3; as the barrier lowers from 2.2 to 0.3 both sides share them, 367 crossings one way and 348 back in the last frame
- `hero.film.emech-eight-steps.label`: eight steps to calm
- `hero.film.emech-eight-steps.note`: simulated annealing of a 12-city tour on an eight-step cooling staircase: a tangle of 22 crossings opens into one calm loop, length 445 down to 157, the best found
- `hero.film.emech-every-give.label`: every give, a take
